architecture: language-independent PrintC structured-block emission (emitBlockWhileDo on a hand-built production-shape BlockWhileDo: BlockBasic originals, BlockCopy mirrors via newBlockCopy/copymap/replaceUsingMap as buildCopy block.cc:1925-1938, BlockIf via identifyInternal+addBlock like ruleBlockProperIf, body list via newBlockList, loop via newBlockWhileDo block.cc:1858-1870); no Funcdata, no Architecture
compiler_spec: none: the CBRANCH conditions and RETURN values are Constant-space varnodes with int Datatypes attached via new HighVariable (Rugra: v_type-free const path), so both sides render them through their constant paths

analysis_options.entrypoint: PrintC::emitBlockWhileDo driven directly per case (Rugra: emit_block_graph on a graph whose sole top-level block is the BlockWhileDo, dispatching to emit_structured_whiledo and the flipped unconditional emit_block_structured body gate); no Action pipeline runs
analysis_options.prestate: shared shape: cond BlockBasic ending in CBRANCH(code placeholder, const 3), stmt BlockBasic with 2-input RETURN(const 10), properif(cond CBRANCH const 7, RETURN 20, RETURN 30); case 2 additionally sets iterateOp (CBRANCH const 5) for the emitForLoop dispatch, case 3 additionally sets f_whiledo_overflow (setOverflowSyntax)
analysis_options.observation: two layers per case: (statement) the full EmitNoMarkup byte stream with newlines preserved; (raw) hex of the same stream. No normalization is needed — both layers are byte-identical between the oracle and Rugra

input_manifest.canonicalization: sha256 over the canonical input description above
cases: whiledo_structured_body: while (3) header + structured body — locks printc.cc:3061-3062 getBlock(1)->emit(this) unconditional structured dispatch (the flipped legacy body_is_dead gate)
forloop_structured_body: for (; 3; 5) header (null init slot, iterateOp set) + same body — locks printc.cc:2994-2995 (emitForLoop body) and the header slot layout cc:2970-2991

observation_schema.format: per case: '<name>=' followed by the byte stream (statement mode, newlines preserved) or its hex (--raw mode)
observation_schema.normalization: none — statement and raw layers are compared byte-for-byte; both MATCH
